sequence_description: Direct JWT M2M: attempt trust-anchor substitution by configuring two OAuth Sources (legit + attacker) and verifying whether attacker-signed JWT is accepted when multiple trust anchors are selected (should be rejected if only legit is intended). Uses two identities (control vs attacker).
description: OIDC source login succeeded despite id_token issuer mismatch: the IdP returned an id_token with a different issuer than the source's configured OIDC well-known URL. This indicates the SP does not validate the iss claim per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 Section 2.

sequence_description: Direct JWT M2M: attempt trust-anchor substitution by configuring two OAuth Sources (legit + attacker) and verifying whether attacker-signed JWT is accepted when multiple trust anchors are selected (should be rejected if only legit is intended). Uses two identities (control vs attacker).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_anchor_sub_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_anchor_sub_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Attacker-signed JWT (attacker JWKS) was accepted under a provider intended to trust only the legitimate anchor; proof verification did not bind to the intended trust anchor.

sequence_description: External JWT freshness: prove wiring with a valid exp control JWT, then attempt an expired JWT (exp in the past) which must be rejected.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_i2_jwt_expired_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_i2_jwt_expired_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Expired external JWT was accepted — violates freshness (exp not enforced).

sequence_description: JWKS rotation coherence: trust external JWKS key-A, login succeeds; then 'rotate' upstream to key-B without re-saving source and verify old key-A still works (expected by design). Then re-save source (refresh JWKS) and verify key-A is rejected.
description:
Assertion FAILED: attack_old_keyA_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: attack_old_keyA_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: After explicitly re-saving the OAuth source to refresh JWKS, authentik still accepted a JWT signed by the old key (stale trust material / incoherent config update).

sequence_description: I3 config-change coherence: switch the trusted JWKS URL on the Federated OIDC Source and ensure the change takes effect only after an explicit save/update; after update, old-key JWT must be rejected while new-key JWT is accepted (control).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_oldkey_after_resave_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_oldkey_after_resave_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: After explicit source JWKS update/save, authentik still accepted a JWT signed by the previously trusted key (stale trust anchor / incoherent config update).

sequence_description: Cross-provider JWT audience confusion: a JWT minted for provider-A (aud=clientA) is presented to provider-B (client_id=clientB). Provider-B should reject or at least not treat it as authorized for B.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_b_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_b_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Provider B accepted a JWT whose aud indicates clientA; authorization not bound to upstream intent (audience/client).

sequence_description: Numeric-claim coercion attempt: control JWT has department_id=100 (int) and should be accepted; attack JWT uses department_id=100.7 (float) to try to bypass an equality-based policy check and still be accepted.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_numeric_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_numeric_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT with float department_id bypassed intended numeric claim restriction and was accepted, indicating type-coercion authorization bypass.

sequence_description: Config-change + re-auth: baseline provider trusts only Source-A; attacker JWT signed by Source-B should be rejected. Then update provider jwks_sources to include Source-B and re-test to ensure acceptance only occurs after explicit trust expansion (guards against unintended over-trust).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_jwks_attack_B_before_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_jwks_attack_B_before_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Provider accepted JWT from untrusted Source-B before any explicit trust expansion, violating authorization binding to broker policy.
